name: technical-english
title_zh: 航天维修手册级英文改写器，专杀AI腔
tagline_zh: 把满屏「furthermore」「leverage」的AI味文档，改写成ASD-STE100标准——短句。
tagline_en: Turns AI-flavored prose into ASD-STE100 aerospace standard: short sentences, one meaning per word, active voice.
desc_en: Rewrite or audit any text using the principles of ASD-STE100 Simplified Technical English, the aerospace writing standard built for flight manuals. Kills AI slop by force - short sentences, one approved meaning per word, active voice, no filler. Use when asked to "simplify this", "de-slop this", "make this clearer", "rewrite in plain English", "apply STE", or when documentation, instructions, READ
why_zh: 不是普通润色，是拿航天级写作规范当筛子。每个词只留一个批准含义，长句强制拆短，被动语态直接标红。
why_en: Not a gentle polish—it enforces ASD-STE100 rules: one approved sense per word, hard sentence splits, passive voice flagged. Far.
limit_zh: 只认英文文本，不处理代码、数学公式或表格。改写后是符合STE的简明英文，不是本地化翻译。对文学性、修辞、幽默无感。
limit_en: English text only; ignores code, math, or tables. Output is STE-compliant plain English, not localization. Literature, rhetoric, and humor get.
title_en: Aerospace-grade plain English rewriter that kills AI slop
